method: Every configured 2026 district is listed. District two-party D-R margin is 100*(D-R)/(D+R), and lean is district margin minus the national margin, using the Wikipedia lead infobox vote totals. Missing candidate totals remain null; no results are imputed.
nationalSourceNote: Totals as currently displayed in the 2026 House elections Wikipedia lead infobox; article remains marked as a current election and results are unofficial.
